decisions.reason: The electronic music box relies on electronic components and knowledge distant from the firm's core wood-processing expertise, reducing its capacity to learn from early results and improve the product.
The wooden nativity stable builds directly on the firm's existing woodworking capabilities, giving it high absorptive capacity to interpret results and keep improving.
The modern incense smoker figurine is anchored in traditional woodcraft with only a design update, so the firm's related knowledge enables it to assimilate feedback and adjust.
